notes.title: Chandra E13 is now available
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44739674/a9fb5dfbeca33614901240344ea1336776e18527.png[/img]
Chandra's Episode 13 hangout is now available in the public demo! This update includes the ability to hang out with Chandra in E13 and unlock her ending in E14 as well as:

[list]
[*] Hints System
[*] Adjusted gamepad mapping
[*] Revamped UI and artwork, (Including Dreadhead Opal!)
[*] Additional VO for some of Sophie's scenes
[*] Fixed issue with some accessibility options loading too slowly
[*] Name tags added to history log for CG scenes
[*] Revamped save pages. Autosaves added to save/load menu
[*] Various bugfixes and issues with character affection overflow
[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44739674/8035aa9a7208e0929ecda9c081545c173769cb40.gif[/img]

Hints and Gamepad manuals have added to the in-game Help menu so check it out!
Chandra's common route walkthrough has also been added to the guides section of the website! ✨ Any error reports should be directed to the contact form on my site or through the discord server.

Saves for the most part should remain compatible but because of the amount of changes to the game, some may no longer work and cause a "rollback error". You will have to either start from the first chapter or find a save from a different time that is still compatible.
